title: FFCI: A Framework for Interpretable Automatic Evaluation of Summarization
reasoning: The paper's focus is on the technical evaluation of text summarization. It introduces metrics for "faithfulness", "focus", "coverage", and "coherence". The term "faithfulness" is used to mean factual consistency between the summary and the source text, a common technical term in summarization and fact-checking. It does not pertain to religious faith, morals, or ethics.
